name: Iron Man
description: Smart inventor who battles in tough armor.
powers: Smart mind. Powered suit. The ability to fly. Repulsor blasts. Missile volleys. Energy guns.

name: Captain America
description: Super soldier and team leader.
powers: Great power. Fast movement. Tough body. Quick recovery. Expert fighting skills. Skilled with shields.

name: Thor
description: Thor, the Norse god of thunder.
powers: Super strength. Lasts a long time. Lightning powers. Controls weather. Can fly. Warrior skills.

name: Hulk
description: Extremely powerful gamma-powered superhero.
powers: Massive strength, durability, regeneration, super jumps.

name: Black Widow
description: Elite spy and Avenger.
powers: Martial arts, acrobatics, espionage, weapons expertise.

name: Hawkeye
description: Master archer and Avenger.
powers: Expert archery, incredible accuracy, trick arrows, combat skills.

name: War Machine
description: Military hero equipped with heavily armed armor.
powers: Powered armor, flight, strength, guns, missiles, energy weapons.

name: Falcon
description: Highly trained aerial hero using advanced wings.
powers: Flight, aerial combat, martial arts, advanced wing technology.

name: Winter Soldier
description: A super soldier and a top assassin became a hero.
powers: Built to do more. It has power and fast movement. There is also quick healing. The person uses a cybernetic arm. It is meant for fighting. Firearms are included.

name: Scarlet Witch
description: A Marvel hero who is a witch with red chaos magic and is really powerful with use of the Darkhold.
powers: Magic. Telekinesis. Telepathy. Reality bending. Energy control.

name: Spider-Man
description: A hero with spider powers. He can climb and move with ease.
powers: Hard strength. Fast moves. A kind of spider awareness. He can climb walls. He fires web lines from his gear.

name: Doctor Strange
description: Sorcerer who guards Earth against strange, dangerous forces.
powers: Magic. Spellcasting. Portals. Teleportation. Shields. Dimensional abilities.

name: Captain Marvel
description: A cosmic hero with huge power. It feels almost unreal. So much strength in one person.
powers: Great strength. The power to fly. High durability. Energy projection. Energy absorption.

name: Ant-Man
description: A superhero can change his body size by using Pym tech. He can make himself bigger or smaller as needed.
powers: Changing size at will. Very high strength. Talking to insects. Pym tech.

name: Wasp
description: The hero got smaller and still had his high-tech gear.
powers: Size manipulation, flight, energy blasts, agility, martial arts.

name: Black Panther
description: A Wakandan hero who gets power from the Heart-Shaped Herb.
powers: Stronger. Faster. Sharper senses. Faster healing too. Trained in martial arts. All while wearing a vibranium suit.

name: Shuri
description: Is a genius scientist in Wakanda, and is King T'Challa's younger sister. Her brother is known as the Black Panther.
powers: Stronger. Faster. More agile. Sharp mind. Vibranium tech that powers it.

name: Okoye
description: Wakandan warrior. Leader of the Dora Milaje.
powers: Spear fighting and close combat training, sharp moves and quick feet. Agility matters in tight fights. You also need tactical leadership, not just strength.

name: Lady Sif
description: A female Asgardian fighter. She has been with Thor for a long time and still stands as his ally.
powers: She is extremely strong and fast. She can take heavy hits and recover wounds. Her sword work is sharp, and her fighting skills are very well trained.

name: Valkryie
description: Legendary Asgardian warrior and former leader of the Valkyrior.
powers: Raw power. Fast movement. Hard to damage. Quick recovery. Skilled sword fighting. Warrior training and technique.

name: The Mighty Thor
description: Jane Foster is an astrophysicist who gets picked by Mjolnir and turns into a strong Asgardian hero.
powers: Raw power, tough build, fast flight, sharp lightning. Skilled with Mjolnir and fights well.

name: Wong
description: Master sorcerer, Sorcerer Supreme in Multiverse of Madness, and is assistant to Dr. Strange.
powers: Magic can open portals. You get energy shields, too. Then there is teleportation. Martial arts rounds it out.

name: Star-Lord
description: Space traveler hero, Gamora's boyfriend, and Leaser of the Guardians of the Galaxy.
powers: Stronger abilities. Expert gun skills. Pilot training. Jet boots. Better weapons.

name: Rocket
description: Brainy genetically changed Guardian.
powers: Skilled at many things, not just one. Good at building complex gear. Knows how weapons work. Can pilot and handle controls.

name: Groot
description: A Guardian of the Galaxy, Rocket's best friend, is a tree with regeneration powers, and helped Thor create Stormbreaker.
powers: Can move plants around. It can heal itself. It has great strength. Its body can grow and change. It can stretch its body far out.

name: Drax
description: A strong warrior and a Guardian of the Galaxy.
powers: Built with great strength and tough skin. Can recover from injuries too. Trained in close fights and knows how to use different weapons.

name: Gamora
description: Peter Quill's girlfriend, Favorite Daughter of Thanos, and Sacrificed herself in order for Thanos to get the Soul Stone.
powers: Been pushed beyond normal limits, in way that shows up in trhe body and the blade, Fights with a blade and also knows martial art techniques.

name: Nebula
description: A cybernetic warrior, sister of Gamora, robotic daughter of Thanos, and an ex-assassin. Future Guardian of the Galaxy.
powers: They have boosted strength and tougher skin.Regrowth helps them heal faster.Cybernetics are built into their body. Their fighting skills were trained for real combat.

name: Mantis
description: Empathic protector with psychic gifts.
powers: Can read feelings, steer thoughts, affect the mind, and help someone fall asleep.

name: Rescue
description: Is Pepper Potts superhero name when she wears an iron man suit from Tony Stark. She fought in the final battle for Earth in Endgame.
powers: Can fly, hits hard and can take a lot of damage and uses her energy weapons

name: Nick Fury
description: Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of the people who set up the Avengers initiation
powers: Training in the field. Work in spying. Hands on with weapons. Led teams in fights.

name: Vision
description: A made-up hero gets its power from the Mind Stone.
powers: He has super strength and can fly. Also slip through things. It can change how dense it is. It can push out energy too.

name: Venom
description: An alien symbiote links to a human host.
powers: It gives the host more power and faster movement. It can regrow injuries too. It can also change form. In addition, it can control tendrils.

name: Shang-Chi
description: Skilled fighter, Dad created the Ten Rings.
powers: He train hard in martial arts. He skills are boosted in a special way. The Ten Rings matter a lot here. He can also work with energy.

name: Jean Grey
description: A mutant with serious power and a psychic edge.
powers: She can read thoughts, move objects with its mind, and control energy. She also has Phoenix-type traits.

name: Deadpool
description: Regening a mutant mercenary.
powers: She regrows parts that were damaged. It also gets tougher, moves quicker, and fights with skill. It can use a blade and it can shoot accurately.

name: Wolverine
description: A mutant with a wild healing ability, plus claws.
powers: They can regrow fast, sense danger early, hit harder, and they have an adamantium frame. The claws come with that too.

name: Heimdall
description: Asgard’s keeper of the Bifrost.
powers: Unusual power. Hard to damage. Sharper senses. Strong sight. Bifrost control.

name: Daredevil
description: A blind superhero relies on strong senses. They pick up tiny sounds and shifts in the air. The focus stays on what they feel and hear.
powers: Stronger senses, like a radar sweep. Quick awareness in every direction. Fighting moves from martial arts. Moves that feel like acrobatics.

name: Moon Knight
description: A fighter with strange powers is tied to Khonshu, the Egyptian god.
powers: More power and tougher materials. Faster recovery and healing. Fight skills that feel beyond normal. Special supernatural abilities in battle.

name: Quicksilver
description: He moves so fast it feels unreal.
powers: Quick speed. Faster reactions. Sharper senses. Fast fights.

name: Silver Surfer
description: A cosmic entity gains power from the Power Cosmic.
powers: Space power. Air travel. Huge strength. Lasting toughness. Changing materials.

name: Ghost Rider
description: Vengeful supernatural spirit.
powers: It has supernatural power. It can heal fast. There is hellfire involved. It uses Penance Stare. It also has mystical abilities.

name: Kingpin
description: A tough crime boss who can really fight in close quarters.
powers: Strength and toughness beyond normal limits. Skilled at fighting in close combat. Strong in planning and directing others.

name: Lady Deathstrike
description: She is a mutant villain. She is also a cybernetically enhanced assassin. Over time, she turns into one of Wolverine’s most dangerous enemies.
powers: Her upgrades include enhanced strength and speed. She is also more durable than before. She can regenerate. She has adamantium fingers. She fights with martial arts.

name: Proxima Midnight
description: Female member of Thanos' Black Order. Deadly alien warrior.
powers: She is built for brutal fights. She has strong muscles and quick movement. She can take a hit and keep going. She fights with skill and knows close combat well. She is trained with a spear.

name: Madame Viper
description: Ruthless terrorist. Assassin. HYDRA leader.
powers: Strong in fights. Skilled at spying. Knows poisons and toxins well. Understands weapons. Moves with extra speed and balance. Leads with a clear plan.

name: Hela
description: Asgardian killer, queen of death, and former queen of asgard
powers: She has great strength and tough durability. Her body can heal itself. She can craft weapons. She uses necromancy. In fights, she is highly skilled.

name: Dark Phoenix
description: A huge cosmic version of Jean Grey. She is linked to the Phoenix Force. She becomes a main enemy.
powers: Mind reading. Moving objects with thought. Shaping energy in the air. Changing what things are made of. Power that feels far beyond Earth. Gliding or flying. A huge force that can wreck a lot. Altering reality itself.
